title: Publish cache entries only after complete catalog loads
description: A timed-out catalog refresh wrote its partial result into the shared cache. Later requests treated that partial list as complete until the TTL expired. Build each refresh in request-local memory, validate the provider result, then replace the shared entry in one write. A failed refresh must keep the last complete entry. A first load with no complete entry still returns the current unavailable response. The cache key and TTL do not change, so existing consumers keep their lookup contract.

commits.title: Make catalog cache publication atomic
commits.body: Preserve the last complete catalog on provider errors.
